items.title: Gerald Wiggins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 2, 1995
items.q: You don’t find that anymore. Yeah with Papa Jo Jones and whoever the bass player was, and Basie, and Freddie on guitar.

ctx.x: Was the Basie band something that you listened to off and on? We’ve talked with some people about the sound of their rhythm section. Was that something that —
Oh, they had a tight rhythm section, yeah. They were together. You don’t find that anymore. Yeah with Papa Jo Jones and whoever the bass player was, and Basie, and Freddie on guitar. Jesus.
Can’t do any better than that.
